hooks.description: Block git commits that contain hardcoded secrets (Supabase JWT, Mapbox, DeepSeek, Exa, Firecrawl, OpenAI, GitHub PAT, AWS), debugger statements, or linter errors.
Block modifications to linter/formatter config files (.eslintrc, .prettierrc, biome.json, ruff.toml, etc.). Fix source code instead of weakening rules.
